subject: general
question: Why does the passage observe that more human-caused earthquakes are expected?

options.text: It is due to the Greenhouse Effect.
It is due to the fragility of the earth.
It is due to the demand for energy and minerals.
It is due to the over soil erosion.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. "It is due to the demand for energy and minerals".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"demand"** means the desire of purchasers, consumers, clients, etc., for a particular commodity, service, or other item. (मांग)

 
 
• **Example:** The demand for electric cars is increasing due to environmental concerns.
 
 
 
• **"Energy"** refers to the capacity for doing work, which can be transformed from one form to another. (ऊर्जा)
 
 
• **Example:** Solar panels are used to convert solar energy into electrical energy.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the passage observes more human-caused earthquakes are expected due to the demand for energy and minerals.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. "It is due to the demand for energy and minerals".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Greenhouse Effect** (ग्रीनहाउस प्रभाव): The trapping of the sun's warmth in a planet's lower atmosphere.

 
 
• **Example:** The greenhouse effect is causing global temperatures to rise.
 
 
 
• **Fragility of the Earth** (पृथ्वी की नाजुकता): The quality of being easily broken or damaged.
 
 
• **Example:** The fragility of the earth's ecosystem is a growing concern.
 
 
 
• **Over Soil Erosion** (अधिक मृदा अपरदन): The process by which soil is removed from an area by wind, water, or other natural agents.
 
 
• **Example:** Over soil erosion can lead to loss of fertile land for agriculture.
